section_summary.extract_value: This Procedures paragraph reports ethics approval and describes community recruitment of Malaysian adults (Malay or Chinese) between May and September 2018 from congregate public locations, with participants completing anonymous paper-and-pencil questionnaires at private portable stations and receiving small gift vouchers. The section does not label this as 'Study 1' or mention multiple studies, nor does it report sample size, demographic percentages, BMI measures, or assessment instruments for body appreciation.
